AC Repair & Maintenance in Dubai

One bedroom stays warm while the living room cools down, or water starts dripping from a ceiling grille. Tell ServiceBay which room and unit are affected. We arrange AC servicing and repair enquiries for Dubai homes and businesses, including Dubai Marina, JVC and Business Bay.

Key benefits

  • More even cooling between rooms
  • Earlier notice of drainage trouble
  • A service record for each unit

What an AC visit can cover

A routine service and a fault visit answer different questions. For routine maintenance, ask for a written list of the filters, accessible coils and drain components included for each unit. For poor cooling, describe when the temperature changes and whether the airflow changes with it. That helps define a diagnostic visit before you agree to a replacement part.

Work you can request

  • Filter and coil cleaning
  • Drain and condensate checks
  • Airflow and thermostat diagnosis
  • Refrigerant, compressor and duct enquiries

Most common problems

  • One room stays warm
  • Weak airflow or recurring noise
  • Water below the indoor unit

Cooling has stopped?

Call with the affected rooms and the time cooling stopped. Dispatch can check the next available AC visit during working hours.

Call dispatch

Service photo

Why regular AC servicing matters

A room can still feel cool while its drain or filter needs attention. Comparing airflow and drainage at later visits helps spot a change early.

Common component failures & expert repair solutions

ComponentWhat you may noticeHow we address it
Filter or coilAirflow falls across several outlets.Clean the affected surface and compare airflow again.
Condensate drainWater collects below the indoor unit.Clear the confirmed obstruction and verify discharge.
Controller sensorRoom temperature differs from the display.Compare readings, then recalibrate or replace a faulty sensor.
Fan assemblyThe indoor unit rattles as speed changes.Check the wheel, mounts and motor before quoting the faulty part.

Before & after service

Before the visit

Record the controller setting, rooms with weak airflow and any water below the indoor unit.

At handover

Check the serviced unit’s response at the controller and ask which airflow, drainage and cooling checks were completed.

Work by property type

Residential

In an apartment, confirm whether the building manages the cooling supply and whether your unit has an accessible service hatch. In a villa, list each affected room and identify any outdoor units visible from ground level. A floor plan is helpful when several rooms share one controller.

Commercial

For an office, salon or shop, identify the room with the complaint and the hours it is occupied. A meeting room that warms up only when full needs a different brief from an entire floor that stays warm before opening.

Industrial

For warehouse office cooling, share ceiling height and access. Walk-in chillers and freezer rooms need a separate refrigeration assessment.

Cold-room refrigeration assessments

AC brands & equipment

For a Carrier, Daikin or LG unit, send the model from a readily visible label. The team can confirm the unit type, service access and compatible parts.

From first call to handover

Send the area, unit count and symptom. We confirm the access requirements and an available visit. After inspection, review the proposed work, any parts and the quoted price. At handover, ask which units were serviced, what changed and which observations still need follow-up.

What affects the estimate?

The service calculator starts from an illustrative AED 180 for one AC unit. Unit count, access, diagnosis and parts can change the written quote. For a multi-unit property, identify the units needing routine care separately from the unit with the fault.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions about AC & HVAC

Does one thermostat mean I have one AC unit?

A controller alone may not identify the equipment serving the room. Send a floor plan, unit schedule or building maintenance contact if you are unsure how many units to enter.

Does servicing include a refrigerant refill?

A refill is a separate item to discuss after the cause of poor cooling has been assessed. Ask for the proposed checks, refrigerant work and price in writing.

Can you check just one warm room?

Yes, describe that room, its controller and whether neighbouring rooms are comfortable. That gives the team a clear starting point for the visit.

Is same-day AC repair available?

Call with your area and access window. The team can confirm appointment availability and whether any required parts would need a second visit.

What should an AC maintenance contract specify?

Ask for the unit list, visit frequency, cleaning scope, fault callout terms and parts exclusions. These details make it easier to compare an AMC with individual services.
